The given equation is \(\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026} x}} = 26x\). Assuming \(x > 0\), rewrite the left side as \(x^{\frac{1}{20} \log_{2026} x}\). Taking logarithms base \(e\) gives

\[
\frac{(\ln x)^2}{20 \ln 2026} = \ln 26 + \ln x.
\]

Let \(t = \ln x\) to obtain the quadratic

\[
t^2 - 20 \ln 2026 \cdot t - 20 \ln 2026 \cdot \ln 26 = 0.
\]

Alternatively, set \(a = \log_{2026} x\), so \(x = 2026^a\), and derive

\[
a^2 - 20a - 20 \log_{2026} 26 = 0.
\]

The sum of the roots is \(a_1 + a_2 = 20\), so the product of the corresponding \(x\)-values is

\[
x_1 x_2 = 2026^{a_1} \cdot 2026^{a_2} = 2026^{a_1 + a_2} = 2026^{20}.
\]

Factor \(2026 = 2 \times 1013\), with both factors prime, so

\[
2026^{20} = 2^{20} \cdot 1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors is \((20 + 1)(20 + 1) = 21^2 = 441\).

\boxed{441}
